name: I'm a love interest in my childhood friend's reverse harem!!!
source:
A not-so-generic otome game with BL possibilities.

Instead of playing the heroine and choosing between several men that have typical dating-sim personalities, you play as the childhood friend. That's right! The route that's usually the easiest to complete is no longer available.

You are thrust into the world of a reverse harem, where your precious childhood friend is being hit on by two of your classmates. You can choose to either play the role of a love interest and try to win the heroine's heart, or... you can play your own game and try to make the two boys fall for you instead! The choice is yours!

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=43&t=55892]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
一款不那么套路、还能发展BL恋情的乙女游戏。

你扮演的并非女主角，也不用在几个带着典型恋爱游戏人设的男人之间作选择，而是她的青梅竹马。没错！通常最容易攻略的那条路线，现在不再是可选路线了。

你被卷入一个逆后宫世界，珍视的青梅竹马正被你的两名同班同学追求。你可以选择扮演恋爱对象，努力赢得女主角的芳心；或者…按自己的方式来，反过来让那两个男生爱上你！选择权在你手中！

[摘自[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=43&t=55892]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
